text: ITEM 1 | Orange-colored cooked vegetable pieces, uniform bright orange with slightly darker orange edges; cut into rounded coin-shaped slices about 2-3 cm across and 0.5-1 cm thick, some oval, with smooth, moist, slightly glossy surface and no visible browning or char; slices are piled loosely in a mound covering roughly 40% of the white square plate's center, with one pale yellow-centered slice at the left edge; sitting directly on the white ceramic plate | 110
